scope: Standard perf --children display from the same complete closed raw. Children percentages are reported rounded values against all recorded user-CPU sample periods, include descendants and overlap across functions; do not add them or turn them into whole-wall/GPU/Amdahl bounds. Integer Period/Samples fields here are exclusive and reconcile exactly with the prior weighted report. Command aggregates are not source/proof or process-lifetime attribution. Generic lean_apply dispatch is not an optimization target in isolation; named Meta and kernel paths require source verification. Unknowns, sampling/attach/unwind limits and shared background remain.
